ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  Niraj Ispat Industries Limited has announced the re-appointment of M/S Vipin Kumar & Company as its Internal Auditor for the Financial Year 2026-2027, effective July 25, 2026. This is a standard corporate governance action, ensuring compliance with SEBI regulations and bolstering internal controls. The disclosure indicates a routine operational update with no material financial impacts or immediate red flags.
